notes:
New
- Default encryption passphrase, set once in Settings with a per-app override, so encrypted backups stop asking every time. (#17)
- Remote-only backups: a backup to Telegram or an rclone cloud remote uploads and keeps no local copy by default (with a Keep a local copy switch), and you can browse and restore straight from an rclone remote. (#16)
- A Staging folder setting controls where a remote or external backup is temporarily assembled.

Fixes
- Update checks and installs now work on every device.
- Turning an installed app into a system app now actually takes effect.
- Failed or interrupted backups no longer leave partial copies piling up.
- Importing a Neo-Backup or Android-DataBackup backup now restores each app with the correct security labels, so it no longer crashes.
- The system-files (/data/adb) backup goes to the destination you choose, with a post-restore reboot hint and scrollable folder names.
- Notifications name the app, not its package id; smoother app and backup search.

Improvements
- The last English-only screens are now translated in all 21 languages.
